versions.changelog: Add GET /v1/brief $0.25 whole-job market brief endpoint

- Added documentation for the new demandex-mcp MCP server/package, including usage instructions, environment variables, tool listing, and free/paid support.
- Updated free-funnel guidance and clarified paid/free endpoint discovery flows.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- SKILL.md rewritten to include MCP tooling support and to reflect current agent integration pathways.

Version 0.2.0

- Added documentation for the new demandex-mcp npm package, an MCP server with built-in x402 payment handling and tool registration for agents.
- Described how to use demandex-mcp with Claude and other MCP clients, including configuration and environmental variables.
- Listed the available free and paid MCP tools with endpoint mapping and prices.
- Noted free-tier mode for demandex-mcp: starts without a wallet and exposes only the free endpoints for learning response shapes.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
Initial public release: 2 free + 5 paid endpoints (trending $0.01, category list $0.02, opportunity card $0.05, gauge $0.03, gauge live $0.10), x402 USDC on Base.
